AC Gas Filling in Narasaraopet

Leak inspection first, then gas filling only when your AC really needs it.

Detailed service information on this page is in English. You can call or WhatsApp us in Telugu, Hindi or English.

Quick answer

When does an AC need gas filling?

An AC needs gas filling only when refrigerant has leaked out. The gas is not used up in normal running. BOBBY first checks cooling and inspects for a refrigerant leak; if gas is low, the leak point is identified so the refill lasts. Call or WhatsApp +91 83748 89163 in Narasaraopet to book a check.

Many customers are told their AC "needs gas" every year. In reality an AC works in a sealed circuit, so if the gas is low, there is a leak somewhere. Not every cooling problem is gas either: dirty filters, a blocked coil or an electrical fault can also cause poor cooling. That is why BOBBY inspects first.

What's included

  • Refrigerant gas leak detection
  • Compressor pressure and pipe connection inspection
  • Vacuuming the system before gas charging
  • Refrigerant refill as per manufacturer standards
  • Cooling efficiency check after gas filling

Common problems

Problems we check and fix

Cooling has slowly reduced

A slow leak lowers the refrigerant over weeks or months.

Ice on the pipes or indoor coil

Low refrigerant or poor airflow can freeze the coil.

Outdoor unit runs but air is not cold

A sign of low refrigerant or a compressor issue that needs checking.

Oily marks at pipe joints

Refrigerant oil at a joint often shows the leak point.

Hissing sound

Can indicate refrigerant escaping from a joint or coil.

Gas needed every season

A repeated top-up means the leak has not been found and fixed.

Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Is AC gas filling needed every year?

No. A healthy AC keeps its refrigerant for many years. If your AC needs gas every season, there is a leak that should be found and repaired.

How much does AC gas filling cost?

It depends on the refrigerant type, how much is needed and whether a leak repair is required. The technician inspects first and gives an estimate before filling.

Can you fill gas without fixing the leak?

We do not recommend it. Without fixing the leak the new gas escapes again and the money is wasted.

Can poor cooling be caused by something other than gas?

Yes. Dirty filters, a blocked coil, a weak capacitor or an electrical fault can all reduce cooling. The inspection checks these before deciding on gas.
